subject: reps: confirm installed criterion, sham on stage, rep length
body: 1) Please confirm or change the installed criterion D-reps-003: 5 good reps (rating >= 7), then the anchor alone must bring rating >= 7 with a rise >= 2, two tests in a row. 2) On stage, sham rate 0, or one pinned sham trial so the progress screen can show recovery after cue vs no cue? 3) Rep length defaults to 32 s (bounds 20-40 s); OK for the demo pacing?
